effects.prompt: Pay {r} to gain +2{d} and destroy when the combat chain closes?

_comment: Follows the ironhide_legs pattern exactly. TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND fires when this equipment defends. MAY block with PAY_RESOURCES cost gates the option - declining runs nothing. On accept: MODIFY_DEFENSE +2 on this defending card, SET_FLAG 'ironhide_helm_boosted' (CURRENT scope = player.current_turn_effects). DELAYED_TRIGGERED ON_COMBAT_CLOSE gated by FLAG_SET destroys the equipment. ENGINE GAP: ON_COMBAT_CLOSE currently dispatches only to combat.attack_card (engine.py:1620-1627); defending equipment never receives it. JSON is semantically correct per printed text.
